function: Beamforming: learned base-station precoder maximizing effective sum-rate for mobile mm-Wave massive MIMO users from inaccurate CSI and user location information (p. 4).
system: Downlink multi-user MIMO: BS with Nt=64 antennas, K=10 users with Nr=16 antennas each, half-wavelength ULAs, 60 GHz mm-Wave; no RIS (pp. 3, 6).
method: Multi-branch CNN (MB-IncepNet, Inception-Shortcut blocks, ULI and CSI sub-networks), trained unsupervised with the negative effective sum-rate as loss (pp. 5-6).
data_channel: DeepMIMO initial CSI and locations, degraded by the aging model (Eq. 3) and location noise (Eq. 8); 100,000 training and 10,000 test samples (pp. 6-7).
test_conditions: Defaults K=10, Nt=64, Nr=16, 10 m/s; sweeps over antennas, users, speed, ULI error (0 or 5 m); retraining per setting not stated (pp. 6-10).
baselines: Non-learned: ideal WMMSE, exhaustive beam search. Learned: MB-ResNet, CSI-prediction CNN, CPFNN, beam-prediction DNN, and own CSI-only SubNet2 (p. 7).
metrics: Effective sum-rate (bps/Hz), its CDF, percentage loss versus ideal WMMSE, and average computation time (pp. 8-10).
complexity: Average computation time in Table I: MB-IncepNet 0.00097-0.00401 s; EBS 0.0256 s; ideal WMMSE 342-5023 s. No FLOPs or parameter count (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 6: "This paper uses DeepMIMO [32] to obtain the initial data sets, including accurate CSI and ULI."
q2_support: p. 7: "The training set contains 100000 random samples, and the test set contains 10000 random samples." Missing: the paper never states that a model trained in one setting is tested in another; the sweeps of antennas, users, speed and ULI error (Table I, Figs. 7-10) do not say whether each point is retrained.
q3_support: p. 8: "the performance of the proposed model MB-IncepNet is better than other DL models, and slightly lower than the ideal WMMSE algorithm [5]". Baselines listed on p. 7: WMMSE, exhaustive beam search, MB-ResNet [6], CNN [18], CPFNN [24], DNN [25]; all compared on effective sum-rate (Table I, p. 8).
q4_support: p. 8: "Table I shows the average sum-rate performance and computation time of various beamforming schemes in different scale networks". The Table I cells are read from the page image: MB-IncepNet 0.00098 s at (K, Nt, Nr, sigma_r) = (10, 64, 8, 0).
q5_support: p. 6: "This paper uses DeepMIMO [32] to obtain the initial data sets, including accurate CSI and ULI." DeepMIMO is a public channel dataset; the paper gives no link to its own code or data.
notes: Included, area 3 (learned beamformer, no RIS, multi-antenna link). q1 and q5 rest on the p. 6 sentence that DeepMIMO supplies the initial CSI and ULI; pp. 6-7 also list Saleh-Valenzuela parameters (L=3, uniform angles) and no DeepMIMO scenario is named, so the reviewer should confirm. q2: the output layers have 2NtKd neurons (p. 5), which ties a model to its antennas and users, but the paper does not say whether it retrains per setting. Table I cells are not in the extracted text; values were read from the page-8 image.
